Package com.egradx.notification.inbox

Class EgradxNotificationPublisher

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.inbox.EgradxNotificationPublisher
public class EgradxNotificationPublisher extends Object
Publishes in-app notifications — the notifications section of the UI.

Each call writes one row, whatever the audience. An organization-wide or platform-wide notification is not copied to each recipient; who sees it is worked out when an inbox is read (see EgradxInboxService). ikon-v9's global notifications wrote one row per user on the platform; this is the design that replaces that.

This never sends anything anywhere else. Publishing an in-app notification does not email, message or text anyone; a caller who wants that too sends it separately, through EgradxNotificationTransport. There is no setting that changes this.

Joins the caller's transaction, like the outbox: a notification about an order appears if and only if the order commits, and connected clients are told only after it has.

An in-process API with no access control of its own. Platform-wide publishing reaches every user of every organization, so whatever exposes it to people — the admin phase's endpoint — must restrict it; that endpoint will require egradx.notification.broadcast.
